brief:
A Palestinian rights organization documented approximately 2,200 Israeli violations targeting Bedouin communities and rural Palestinian areas during September, Shehab Wire reported. The Al-Badr Organization for the Defense of the Rights of Bedouins and Targeted Villages issued the warning as part of its monitoring efforts.

The organization cautioned that the pace of attacks is escalating against these vulnerable settlements across the West Bank.

title: Israeli forces commit 2,200 violations against Bedouin settlements in September
